name: test_admin_cleanup_reports_all_failures_and_continues
description:
Objective: Admin cleanup reports all failures and continues.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/admin/test_admin_cleanup.py.
3. Create only the isolated fixture/state encoded in the authoritative test definition; do not substitute customer data.
4. Invoke `_registered_dependency_cleanup.cleanup` with the recorded partition and capture its return value or raised error.
5. Evaluate the deterministic assertion(s): `pytest.raises(AssertionError)`; `"team 'QA Team Safe': team dependency remains" in message`; `"permission_set 'QA Permission Safe': permission is still in use" in message`; `'role:delete:QA Role Safe' in events`.
6. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: Admin cleanup reports all failures and continues.
2. The authoritative deterministic expression(s) evaluate as encoded: `pytest.raises(AssertionError)`; `"team 'QA Team Safe': team dependency remains" in message`; `"permission_set 'QA Permission Safe': permission is still in use" in message`; `'role:delete:QA Role Safe' in events`.
3. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
